title: About Adkins Preparatory School
description: Discover Adkins Preparatory School's mission, values, and approach to education in Lower Primary and Upper Primary.

hero.heading: A school built on care and character
hero.description: Adkins combines warm relationships with purposeful learning so children feel secure, work hard, and grow into capable, confident, respectful people.

intro.heading: Excellence through nurture and discipline
intro.text: We believe children thrive when adults are caring, consistent, and clear about expectations. Lower Primary and Upper Primary combine encouragement with high standards, helping every learner develop confidence and responsibility.
